text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting diagnostic results—minor
damage.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The probability of worsening is low,
but... I have
determined that I'm still
capable of physical
activity if I
successfully keep my power in check.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Requesting permission to continue with
training. I
will successfully complete
today's tasks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Requesting permission to continue with
training. I
will successfully complete
today's tasks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You're... worried?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. I apologize for
causing you
concern.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing operation—"recuperating
to avoid
causing you concern."

And so, Mihono Bourbon rests to
recover from
her injury.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Commencing

operation—"continuation of
limited-strength
training."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Restricting power output in
consideration of the
damaged body part.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: First, I'll try fifty percent power output!
Thud!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pain in... damaged area... confirmed...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. Even at 50% power output...
my
injury seems to have been irritated.

Realizing that any exercise will just make
her
condition worse, I advise her to rest
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No pain at fifty percent output.
Threshold
cleared. Next is fifty-five
percent!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting. I have verified that I am
capable of
training at up to sixty-five
percent power output.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I propose revising our training regimen
based
upon this data.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will show you that I can reliably
execute any
regimen I am given.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is all for you, for instructing me and
believing
that I could successfully limit
my power output.

Making an immediate comeback,
Mihono
Bourbon succeeds in limiting her
power and fully
completes the revised
regimen!
